name: @tamb/gamegrid
description: A 2D HTML grid for creating web games (or other things that could use a 2D matrix)

scripts.build.safe: npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:dist
scripts.gh-pages: node scripts/prepare-gh-pages.js && npm run build && npm run demo:install && npm run docs && node scripts/build-demo-gh-pages.js
scripts.safe.publish: npm run build.safe && npm publish --access public
scripts.publish:prod: npm run build.safe && npm publish --access public && npm dist-tag add @tamb/gamegrid@$npm_package_version latest
scripts.demo:clean: npm run clean && npm --prefix demo run clean
scripts.demo:prepare: npm run build && npm run demo:install
scripts.demo:build: npm run demo:prepare && npm --prefix demo run build
scripts.demo:link: npm run demo:link:lib && npm run demo:install && npm --prefix demo link @tamb/gamegrid
scripts.demo: npm run demo:clean && npm run demo:prepare && npm run demo:start
scripts.demo:safe: npm run demo:clean && npm run demo:test && npm run demo:prepare && npm run demo:start

author: ¡Támb!
